resources.string: Lets JARVIS open apps, tap buttons, scroll and read the screen when you ask. It never reads password fields.

To enable: Settings, Accessibility, Installed apps, JARVIS, turn on. If it is greyed out: Phone Settings, Apps, JARVIS, three dots (top right), Allow restricted settings. Then try again. Risky buttons (Send, Pay, Delete, Buy, Call) always ask you first.
